text:
noah: Quick catch from the docs CI: PR #623's Optimize migration section has two problems causing snippet-exec + link-checker failures.

noah: Failures noted in the artifact: https://ci.redwood.example/623/artifacts (snippet-exec: 1, links: 2).

rachel: Which snippets? I skimmed the PR but missed the CI output.

noah: The quantization example still shows the pre-0.9 API:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
q = QuantProfile(precision='int8', calibrate=True)
```
noah: That breaks our snippet runner because `calibrate` was removed and dtype names changed.

toni: Replace with the new pattern we use in infra tests:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```

toni: Also two docs pages link to `/optkit/quant-profiles` which 404s. The canonical path is `/optimize/quantization`.

rachel: I'll make a tiny PR that updates the links and swaps the code sample. I'll keep wording minimal so reviewer load is small.

noah: Thanks. One more thing: several runtime examples still use the old flag `kv_cache_enabled: true` in YAML. Runtime accepts `kv_prefetch: auto|on|off` now. Those don't fail snippet-exec but are misleading. Can you grep and fix?

rachel: YepI'll run a repo-wide search for `kv_cache_enabled` and replace with `kv_prefetch: 'auto'` where appropriate.

docs-ci: PR #623  snippet-exec: failed (1), link-checker: 2 broken links. Rerun after fixes: https://ci.redwood.example/623/rerun

toni: I'll add a small smoke test under docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py that executes the quant snippet in CI. That will prevent future regressions caused by API drift.

rachel: Planning to open the fix PR in ~20m and will cc @toni to add the test or I can include a placeholder.

noah: Please add a short migration note to the guide: "SDK <0.9 -> >=0.9: replace QuantProfile(precision=...) with QuantProfile(dtype=...) and use a calibrator object (DefaultCalibrator) instead of calibrate=True."

toni: Good call. I'll also update the snippet test to assert the object has a `dtype` attribute so it fails loudly when API changes again.

rachel: Pinged in PR description: assigned link fixes to me, snippet test to @toni, migration note to me as well.

docs-ci: Re-run requested by rachel  https://ci.redwood.example/623/rerun/1

noah: Great. If CI still fails after those changes, we'll hold the docs sync and triage in #release-war-room. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
